stories.headline: SpaceX catches Starship's upper stage with tower arms after 22-hour Flight 15; booster catch aborted

key_facts.fact: SpaceX made the first successful catch of a Starship upper stage at the launch tower after Flight 15, a milestone toward full reusability.
key_facts.excerpt: A SpaceX realizou a primeira captura bem-sucedida do estágio superior da Starship na torre de lançamento, um marco para a reutilização total do veículo após o 15º voo de teste.

key_facts.fact: Starship returned to Earth after 22 hours in space and was caught in the air by SpaceX's tower.
key_facts.excerpt: Starship retorna à Terra após 22 horas no espaço e é capturada no ar pela SpaceX

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk said the ship was completing 14 orbits of Earth before deorbiting and attempting to land at Starbase.
key_facts.excerpt: Starship is currently completing 14 orbits of Earth, before initiating deorbit and attempting to land in Starbase

key_facts.fact: SpaceX said the Flight 15 Super Heavy booster aborted its 'chopsticks' landing catch after launch because of a guidance issue.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX says Starship Flight 15 booster aborted 'chopsticks' landing catch after launch due to guidance issue (video)

key_facts.fact: The booster, whose catch was aborted, ended up landing in the Gulf of Mexico rather than on the tower, thwarting the planned double catch.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX’s bid for Starship double catch thwarted, as booster ends up in ocean

stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can buy for users, with Visa, Mastercard and Amex

key_facts.fact: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its AI agents make purchases on behalf of users; it is available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are over 18.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its dots AI agents make purchases on behalf of users, available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are over 18 (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)

key_facts.fact: The feature lets agents make secure purchases using payment tokens and biometric verification.
key_facts.excerpt: A nova funcionalidade permite que agentes de IA realizem compras seguras em nome de usuários, utilizando tokens de pagamento e verificação biométrica.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI President Greg Brockman said purchases are made in partnership with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.
key_facts.excerpt: make secure purchases with your dot, in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa

key_facts.fact: TechCrunch described the Wallet as letting AI agents shop and check out for the user.

stories.headline: Italy fines Meta €805M for allegedly accessing Android users' photos and videos without consent

key_facts.fact: Italy's data protection agency fined Meta €805 million for allegedly accessing Android users' photos and videos without their consent or informing them, per Reuters.
key_facts.excerpt: Italy's data protection agency fines Meta €805M for allegedly accessing Android users' photos and videos without their consent or informing them (Reuters)

key_facts.fact: The regulator said Meta lacked specific consent and adequate information when accessing Android users' photos and videos.
key_facts.excerpt: Autoridade de proteção de dados italiana puniu a Meta por acessar fotos e vídeos de usuários do Android sem consentimento específico ou informação adequada.

key_facts.fact: G1 put the fine at about R$5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Itália multa Meta em R$ 5 bilhões por acessar fotos e vídeos de usuários sem consentimento

key_facts.fact: InfoMoney converted the fine to US$887 million, and BBC headlined it as 'Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos'.
key_facts.excerpt: Itália multa Meta em US$ 887 milhões por acesso a dados de usuários do Android

key_facts.excerpt: Tighter AI chip export rules are gaining bipartisan support in Congress, including a bill to block Chinese companies from accessing chips overseas

key_facts.fact: The FT said Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy 'increases momentum' to crack down on US hardware reaching China.

key_facts.fact: Allies of President Trump are rushing to pass restrictions on chips to China after the Nvidia case, per Folha.
key_facts.excerpt: Após caso Nvidia, aliados de Trump correm para aprovar restrição a chips para China

key_facts.fact: The US government faces criticism over the Nvidia case, with the ex-CEO linked to an executive suspected of espionage and diverting chips to China.

stories.headline: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces retreat from Bab el-Mandeb, handing Houthis a Red Sea trade route

key_facts.fact: Saudi-backed forces left strategic positions on the Red Sea to reinforce Aden's security, letting Houthi militias advance in the area.
key_facts.excerpt: Tropas apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita deixaram posições estratégicas no Mar Vermelho para reforçar a segurança de Áden, permitindo o avanço de milícias houthis na região.

key_facts.fact: G1 said the retreat expands Houthi power over a route of global trade.
key_facts.excerpt: Recuo de forças do Iêmen amplia poder dos houthis sobre rota do comércio global

key_facts.fact: The FT framed the Saudi-backed retreat from the Red Sea as a win for the Houthis; the NYT reported the same withdrawal as the Houthis advance.
key_facts.excerpt: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces retreat from Red Sea in win for Houthis

key_facts.fact: InfoMoney described Iran as pressing the US on two fronts: drones over Bahrain and the Houthi advance in Yemen.
